description: A minimal, hotel-quality bedroom bedside vignette photographed at seated eye-level with a normal-to-telephoto lens, framing an off-center tight view of one side of the bed. The bed features a tall upholstered headboard in warm cream crosshatch linen fabric, dressed with layered pillows in ivory and warm greige linen. A floating shelf-style nightstand in pale blonde oak is mounted directly to the wall beside the headboard, its thin open body cantilevered out with a lower shelf slot. On the nightstand surface sits a small white ceramic round-bodied vase holding a loose posy of dried pink gypsophila flowers, and a soft-cover fashion book — a Dior title — placed beneath it. A black square dual electrical outlet module is mounted directly to the wall below the nightstand shelf. On the wall above and to the right of the headboard, a slim brass-framed rectangular wall-mounted reading element with a pivoting spot arm casts a directed narrow cone of warm white light pointing gently downward toward the pillow zone. A panel of pale warm grey or soft white painted or upholstered wall material frames the composition, and a floor-length drape in warm oatmeal linen hangs at the right edge. The mood is serene, contemporary, and understated-luxe.
